attribution.control_2: pure arithmetic reproduces bit-for-bit in BOTH files (m1det = m1src(1+z), m2src = q m1src, sigma_chieff = 0.2*8/rho): only the transcendental power evaluations drift

detail.why_it_is_not_wrong: in darksirens 'shared_spin' means one spin component shared across the MASS components of one population mixture (grammar.py:289-291, base.py:425-428), which is still true here; it has never meant shared across tracer branches
detail.but: STATE.md flagged this attribute as a reader trap. The branch spins are recorded separately and unambiguously in dmu_chi_agn = 0.1, mu_chi_gal = 0.0, mu_chi_agn = 0.1, sigma_chi = 0.1 and in the metadata branch_spin block. Any Gate-C reader must take the branch spin from those, not from shared_spin
